general_anesthesia.why: General anesthesia/intubation is associated with longer cases and is strongly correlated with positive residuals.

adhesions.why: Adhesions increase operative complexity and time; notes mention adhesions and extensive dissection.

heparinization.why: Intraoperative heparin use often reflects vascular/cardiac complexity and longer duration.

estimated_blood_loss_ml.why: Higher blood loss is a direct marker of more complex or prolonged surgery.

multiple_procedures.why: Multiple or additional procedures usually extend operative time beyond the table prediction.

extensive_or_complex.why: Narrative descriptors of complexity often capture extra time not encoded by specialty alone.

laparoscopic_or_robotic.why: Minimally invasive cases with ports/CO2/robotics can be longer when complexity is high and are common in positive residual notes.

effusion_or_fluid.why: Unexpected fluid collections or infection-related findings can add drainage, exploration, and operative time.
